Standard: Each air vehicle with bailout capability has at least one exit that can be operated by an occupant from inside the air vehicle under the anticipated operational environments. Egress exits and provisions allow for clearance away from hazardous areas of the air vehicle (e.g., near propellers, or jet engine inlets or outlets, or air vehicle structure) during bailout. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examination of engineering drawings or digital models verify that an air vehicle with a bailout capability has an external exit with a door that can be opened internally.
(2) Examination of the air vehicle configuration with a bailout capability has an external exit with a door that can be opened internally.
(3) Examination of engineering drawings or digital models verifies that exit locations and bailout provisions are away from hazardous areas around the air vehicle. Demonstration.
  (1) Verify the ability to operate doors internally on a representative mockup or air vehicle under anticipated operational environments by human subjects representing the intended anthropometric population.
